translations.word: Inflation Rate|The average rate of change in consumer prices between two periods, the first called the base period and the second the comparison period. The calculation of the inflation rate relies on the Consumer Price Index (CPI). The higher this index rises, the greater the negative impact of price changes on different segments of society, particularly wage earners and those with fixed incomes. Comparing this rate with the interest rate on savings indicates whether the real interest rate is negative or positive, highlighting the effect of the real interest rate on individuals’ propensity to save.
